# DAVID888 WIKI

> DAVID888 WIKI (Serverless Cloud Notepad) is a private-first serverless wiki and notepad built on Cloudflare Workers, KV, R2, and D1, providing high-performance Markdown and BlockNote editing, real-time collaboration, and agent publishing interfaces.

## 核心服務與頁面 (Core Services & Pages)

- [Home / Editor](https://wiki.david888.com/): Main note workspace and editor with custom themes and real-time autosave.
- [Block Note Editor](https://wiki.david888.com/new/block): Instantiate a new rich BlockNote document.
- [Markdown Note Editor](https://wiki.david888.com/new/markdown): Instantiate a new standard Markdown document.
- [Canvas](https://wiki.david888.com/new/canvas): Instantiate a JSON Canvas 1.0 card-and-connection workspace using shared React Flow UI-style BaseNode/BaseHandle anatomy and native NodeToolbar/EdgeToolbar patterns. It provides an editable title, node color/duplicate/delete controls, Undo/Redo, box selection, multi-drag, bulk color/delete, Cmd/Ctrl+F search, SVG/PNG export, WikiLink graph generation, Camera Tour playback, responsive mobile fit view, local draft restoration with viewport refit, dark-mode styling, bilingual starter templates, visible four-sided handles, a flow-sized SVG edge layer, visible SVG relationship strokes, valid React Flow marker URLs, edge label, arrow, line-style, width, and color controls, image/file/audio/video resource nodes, and a left-aligned Add menu with a fixed icon column. Unpublished drafts remain local until publishing or published-note autosave syncs them to the cloud. Canvas assets use cache-busted `?v=3.9` URLs. Publishing persists the current Canvas JSON. Use its Canvas toolbar for `.canvas` files; the Footer Import content menu remains available for document/audio/URL workflows.
- [Canvas Agent Tools](https://wiki.david888.com/mcp): WebMCP exposes `validate_canvas`, `write_canvas`, `read_canvas`, and `generate_canvas_from_wikilinks` for agents that need to draw visual relationship maps or convert Markdown `[[WikiLink]]` references into graph cards. Canvas notes can be linked as interactive chapters in Book Mode. Resource nodes support images, files, audio, and video through R2 and 888box uploads.
- [Image OCR & Table Reconstruction](https://wiki.david888.com/new/markdown): Paste or drop an image to choose R2 upload, local PP-OCRv6 text recognition, or server table reconstruction via `/api/ocr?mode=table`; local OCR keeps the image on the device and table mode returns clean GFM through `data.tableMarkdown`.

## AI Agent & API Discovery

- [Agent Skill](https://wiki.david888.com/.well-known/agent-skills/david888-wiki-publisher/SKILL.md): Instructions for agents that read, write, publish, upload, and share notes.
- [Agent Skills Index](https://wiki.david888.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): Index of machine-readable agent skills (v0.2.0 schema).
- [API Catalog](https://wiki.david888.com/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 Linkset catalog for API discovery.
- [API Documentation](https://wiki.david888.com/docs/api): Concise Markdown reference for the REST API.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://wiki.david888.com/openapi.json): Machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 contract.
- [Authentication Guidance](https://wiki.david888.com/auth.md): Note-level password access control model details.
- [Robots Policy](https://wiki.david888.com/robots.txt): Machine access controls and AI content signals.
- [Public Sitemap](https://wiki.david888.com/sitemap.xml): Publicly indexed share pages only.
